    def verify_record(

    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        """Verify a single record by index, including any covering epochs."""
        if not (0 <= index < len(self._records)):

        ok, msg = self._verify_single(index, self._records[index], verifier=verifier)
        if not ok:
            return ok, msg

        covering_epochs = [e for e in self._epochs if index < e.get("record_count", 0)]
        if not covering_epochs:
            return True, "OK (record valid but not sealed into any epoch)"

        epoch_errors: list[str] = []
        for epoch in covering_epochs:
            e_ok, e_msg = self._verify_epoch(epoch)
            if not e_ok:
                epoch_errors.append(
                    f"epoch {epoch.get('epoch_index', '?')}: {e_msg}"
                )

        if epoch_errors:
            return False, "; ".join(epoch_errors)
        return True, f"OK (record valid and anchored in {len(covering_epochs)} epoch(s))"
